llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Chinese K12 classroom-coaching aid that uses limited classroom-planning records and does not contain executable, hidden, or credential-seeking behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly designed for Mainland China Chinese K12 settings; use outside that locale requires localization of language, curriculum assumptions, and crisis-help channels.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown and one JSON schema only; no executable scripts, install hooks, network fetches, or package dependencies were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to teaching workflow, classroom questioning, group work, cold-call/cold-room handling, feedback, and post-class observation; adjacent tasks are routed to other skills.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent use is limited and disclosed: it writes teacher-confirmed aggregate interactionLogs, avoids student names in those logs, provides view/correct/delete/pause/export controls, and honors no-sharing requests.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is classroom interaction coaching for teachers, and the capabilities fit that purpose: reading class profile, lesson plans, student tiers, and writing only aggregate interaction logs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese-language K12 teacher workflows where classroom records may be used. Before using it elsewhere, localize curriculum assumptions, emergency-support channels, and language. Teachers should review any generated interaction log before saving and use the provided pause/delete/sharing controls when records should not be retained or shared.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger phrases are broad classroom-help phrases, but they match the skill's stated classroom-coaching purpose. Because writeback is disclosed, teacher-confirmed, and limited to aggregate interaction logs, this does not justify Review on its own.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only materials and schema literals are consistent with the explicit Mainland China Chinese K12 scope stated in shared platform conventions. This is a deployment-suitability note rather than hidden or unsafe behavior.
